name: io.github.koten-ai/zeus-dev-helper
title: Zeus Dev Helper
description: Coach first Zeus Client app to green (stdio MCP).

environmentVariables.name: ZEUS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public Zeus API base URL (port 8080, never Hub :9091).

environmentVariables.name: ZEUS_BUCKET
environmentVariables.description: Default bucket for bootstrap and auth probes.

environmentVariables.name: ZEUS_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Default scope for bootstrap and auth probes.

environmentVariables.name: ZEUS_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Zeus basic-auth username (presence only; never logged).

environmentVariables.name: ZEUS_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Zeus basic-auth password (presence only; never logged).

environmentVariables.name: ZEUS_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Zeus bearer token (presence only; never logged).

environmentVariables.name: ZEUS_CHAT_REQUEST_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Local clone of zeus_chat_request for offline min templates.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub token to fetch private zeus_chat_request catalogs.

environmentVariables.name: DEMO_TRAVEL_SAMPLE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Local clone of demo_travel_sample for travel_golden_path.

environmentVariables.name: ZEUS_DEV_HELPER_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Static toolsets: core (default) plus catalog,lint,travel,support,handoff or all.
